R/Pharma is thrilled to bring 25 workshops across Europe/US and Asia Pacific timezones.  Workshops will run between September 28th and October 1st.  Registration is via the R/Pharma [registration page](https://events.zoom.us/ev/Ao58QRuKpY_AuvCDVGqF3tiibvbsLw6MKXn7n_PL2vPdHVQnSAuC~AulApVxluxkRoEef4TZ6ozp1uwmnBHGti8cDERG7p01yOGKH0KXFbLhUNw).

::: {.hero-buttons}
[R/Pharma 2026 Registration](https://events.zoom.us/ev/Ao58QRuKpY_AuvCDVGqF3tiibvbsLw6MKXn7n_PL2vPdHVQnSAuC~AulApVxluxkRoEef4TZ6ozp1uwmnBHGti8cDERG7p01yOGKH0KXFbLhUNw){.btn-action-success .btn-action .btn .btn-success .btn-lg role="button" target="_blank"}
::: 

A huge thank you to all the workshop presenters who are giving their time to put together and teach such amazing content!  Be sure to register to attend.
